binary_policy: ONNX binaries are never committed. `*.onnx` is Git-ignored and each artifact must be fetched or installed locally, then verified against a recorded SHA-256.

blocked_reasons: No owner-consented European-plum detection dataset has been released, so no checkpoint can be trained.
No reviewed model card, held-out site/season evaluation, or approval record exists for a fruit detector.
Generic COCO/ImageNet YOLOv8n weights detect no fruit class; presenting one as a plum detector would fabricate model evidence.
GitHub release assets are unreachable from the validation sandbox, so third-party weights can only arrive through a pinned source archive or a mirrored artifact store.
acceptance_requirements: A reviewed dataset manifest with owner consent and held-out sites/seasons.
A recorded SHA-256 and byte size for the exact quantized artifact.
A model card stating architecture, quantization, class names, input size, and evaluation metrics.
Coordinator review recorded in SPEC_TRACEABILITY.md before any operational claim.

artifacts.license_notes: The upstream repository is MIT, but the ONNX metadata records Ultralytics' AGPL-3.0 license because the weights are a YOLOv8 export (Ultralytics 8.4.37). This tooling treats the artifact as AGPL-3.0-only: installing it requires an explicit `--accept-license AGPL-3.0-only`, and nothing derived from it may ship without a license review. Weights are never committed.
artifacts.training_provenance: YOLOv8n exported by Ultralytics 8.4.37 on 2026-04-11 from best.pt trained for 50 epochs at imgsz=320 on the Rotten Fruit Detector Dataset v3 (Mendeley xkbjx8959c/2). The upstream README reports mAP@50 0.9897, precision 0.9817 and recall 0.9779 on its own validation split. Classes are fresh/rotten quality labels for apple, banana, orange and pomegranate; the checkpoint has no plum class, no HarvestGrid site or season in its evaluation, and no HarvestGrid review.
acceptance_requirements: A license review of AGPL-3.0-only weights before any product integration.
HarvestGrid-collected evaluation on held-out sites and seasons before any operational claim.
A documented mapping from the fresh/rotten classes to HarvestGrid feature semantics (the runtime currently reports class-agnostic cluster boxes).
Coordinator review recorded in SPEC_TRACEABILITY.md before any operational claim.

blocked_reasons: Synthetic artifact generated inside tests to exercise preprocessing, decoding, NMS, and privacy masking. It has no trained weights and detects nothing.
acceptance_requirements: Never referenced by the walking path, the API, or any forecast input.
